About MindMaze Therapeutics 
 MindMaze Therapeutics, a publicly listed, innovative scale-up headquartered in Switzerland, at the forefront of neuro-therapeutics and digital brain health solutions. Operating in a regulated medical device environment, MindMaze Therapeutics is dedicated to developing cutting-edge technology that supports neurological recovery and treatment.
 As the company continues to grow and expand its specialized activities, we are looking for a dedicated Junior IT Support to join our Cluj office. You will be the first point of contact for day-to-day IT questions and problems across the company, and you will help keep our core platforms — Google Workspace, Jira, our device fleet and Active Directory — running smoothly.
 Part of the people you support sit in Lausanne, Switzerland, so a good share of your work happens remotely: clear written communication and a bit of patience matter as much as technical skills.
 Responsibilities 
 Day-to-day support 
Be the first line of support for hardware, software, access and connectivity issues, in person in Cluj-Napoca and remotely for colleagues in Lausanne,
Log, triage and resolve tickets,
Set up new joiners: accounts, devices, access rights and a proper first-day welcome to our tools — and handle leavers cleanly,
Prepare, image and hand over laptops, monitors, phones and meeting-room equipment; keep the asset inventory accurate.
Write and maintain short how-to guides so common questions stop coming back.
 Google Workspace 
Manage users, groups and org units in the Google Admin console,
Handle Gmail, Drive and shared drive administration: sharing permissions, storage, delegation and recovery requests,
Support colleagues with Meet, Calendar and Drive in everyday use, including meeting-room setups.
 Jira administration 
Administer Jira day to day: users and groups, project access, boards, workflows and simple automation rules,
Create and adjust projects, issue types and permission schemes under the guidance of the senior team,
Help colleagues use Jira well — and keep the configuration tidy as teams grow.
 Devices and identity 
Enrol and manage devices through our MDM: policies, compliance, application deployment, updates and remote wipe when needed,
Perform Active Directory administration: user and group accounts, permissions, group policies and password resets,
Apply our security basics consistently — MFA, disk encryption, patching and least-privilege access.
 What we're looking for 
Familiarity with Google Workspace, and comfort finding your way around an admin console,
Understanding of Windows and macOS, and of how networks work (IP, DNS, Wi-Fi, VPN),
Some exposure to Active Directory, MDM or Jira,
Good written and spoken English: much of your support happens over chat and email with colleagues abroad,
A service mindset: you explain things without jargon, you follow up, and you do not leave someone stuck,
Methodical problem-solving — you check the obvious first, document what you tried, and know when to escalate,
Discretion: you will handle accounts and data that require confidentiality.
 Nice to have 
A degree or certification in IT, computer science or a related field (CompTIA A+, ITIL, Google Workspace Administrator or similar),
Experience with an MDM platform,
Basic scripting — PowerShell, Bash or Python — to automate repetitive tasks,
Experience supporting users across multiple sites or countries.
